description: This file defines a custom exception class 'LoanApplicationNotInSubmittedAndPendingApprovalStateCannotBeDeleted' used within the loan account module of the Fineract platform. It extends an abstract domain rule exception to signal invalid deletion attempts based on the loan application's state.

classes.name: LoanApplicationNotInSubmittedAndPendingApprovalStateCannotBeDeleted
classes.description: A domain exception indicating that a loan application cannot be deleted because it is not in the 'Submitted' or 'PendingApproval' states.

methods.name: LoanApplicationNotInSubmittedAndPendingApprovalStateCannotBeDeleted
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific message indicating the loan's current state and that it cannot be deleted.
